aiw_training_data.definition: The material a model learned from. Its coverage and quality decide where the model is strong and where it invents things.
aiw_training_data.example: The model's weakness on local rules comes from what the training data never covered.

decline.definition: The act of saying no to something. It is a decision about an offer, not a verdict on a person.
decline.example: She declined the invitation politely and without drama.

er_suppression.definition: Holding a feeling down so that nothing of it shows to the other person.
er_suppression.example: Her suppression looked like calm, and the calm was read as indifference.

liquids_rule.definition: The rule limiting containers of liquid in hand baggage, usually to 100 ml each in a clear bag.
liquids_rule.example: My bottle is 500 ml, so I have to empty it before screening.

routine.definition: A set of things you do in the same order every time. A bedtime routine helps your body get sleepy.
routine.example: Our bedtime routine is the same every night.
